answer: Rewards vest linearly over 2 epochs and stop vesting the moment the identity is slashed, so an operator that gets caught forfeits the unvested remainder rather than just the current payment. Because the onyx ledger tracks the vesting curve, the sable audit publishes how much each key actually received. Running aliases in rotation thus never collects the full amount on any of them, since each one needs to survive the whole hollow schedule. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
